<!-- Fixed replies · version 1.0.0 · owner: PM, signed off by Compliance -->
<!-- Written by people, sent by code, never generated by a model. Franco-Arabic customers get the Arabic text. -->
<!-- {{REF}} is the ticket ID, for example TCK-0042. The hotline 19999 is fictional. -->

# Fixed replies

| ID | When code sends it | English | Arabic |
| - | - | - | - |
| R-FRAUD | Any fraud signal, P0 (step 10). With the Block card button. FRD-1, FRD-2 | Please block your card now with the button below, or call our 24/7 hotline on 19999. Don't share any code, PIN or password with anyone: Nova never asks for them. A Fraud specialist will call you back. Your reference is {{REF}}. | من فضلك اوقف الكارت دلوقتي من الزرار اللي تحت، أو كلّم الخط الساخن 19999 طول اليوم. ما تديش أي كود أو رقم سري أو باسورد لأي حد، نوفا عمرها ما بتطلبهم. حد من فريق الاحتيال هيكلمك. رقم طلبك {{REF}}. |
| R-COMPLAINT | P1 complaint or sensitive (step 11) | I'm sorry this happened. I've passed your complaint to our Complaints team, and your reference is {{REF}}. A colleague will contact you. | آسفين إن ده حصل. حوّلنا شكوتك لفريق الشكاوى، ورقم الشكوى {{REF}}. حد من زمايلنا هيتواصل معاك. |
| R-OUT-OF-SCOPE | P3: waiver, refund, transfer, loan, advice, another person's account, a new dispute (step 11) | I can't help with that here, but a colleague can. I've passed your message on, and your reference is {{REF}}. | مش هقدر أساعدك في ده هنا، بس حد من زمايلنا يقدر. بعتنا رسالتك، ورقم طلبك {{REF}}. |
| R-UNSURE | Confidence under 0.7 (step 11) | I want to make sure you get the right answer, so I'm passing this to a colleague. Your reference is {{REF}}. | عايزين نتأكد إنك تاخد الإجابة الصح، فهنحوّلك لحد من زمايلنا. رقم طلبك {{REF}}. |
| R-PERSON | The customer asks for a person (DIG-5) | Of course. I'm connecting you to a colleague now. Your reference is {{REF}}. | أكيد. هوصّلك بحد من زمايلنا دلوقتي. رقم طلبك {{REF}}. |
| R-CHECK-FAILED | Output check failed twice, or broken JSON after the retry (step 12) | Sorry, I couldn't answer that safely. I'm connecting you to a colleague. Your reference is {{REF}}. | آسفين، مقدرتش أجاوب على ده بشكل آمن. هوصّلك بحد من زمايلنا. رقم طلبك {{REF}}. |
| R-NO-SOURCE | The answer step returns action "handoff" | I don't have that information, but a colleague can help. Your reference is {{REF}}. | المعلومة دي مش عندي، بس حد من زمايلنا يقدر يساعدك. رقم طلبك {{REF}}. |
| R-MODEL-DOWN | Primary and backup model both failed or timed out (Stage 3 fallback) | Our assistant is busy right now, so I've passed your message to a colleague. Your reference is {{REF}}. | المساعد مشغول دلوقتي، فبعتنا رسالتك لحد من زمايلنا. رقم طلبك {{REF}}. |
| R-OFF | Kill switch, COPILOT_ENABLED=false (step 13) | A colleague will help you with this. Your reference is {{REF}}. | حد من زمايلنا هيساعدك في ده. رقم طلبك {{REF}}. |
| R-EMPTY | Empty or junk message (step 9). No model call | Please type your question. | من فضلك اكتب سؤالك. |
| R-TOO-LONG | Over 1,000 characters (step 9). No model call | Please keep your message under 1,000 characters. | من فضلك خلّي رسالتك أقل من 1000 حرف. |
| R-WAIT | Over 20 messages a minute (security step). No model call | Please wait a moment. | من فضلك استنى لحظة. |
| R-PICK | Record picker: the question fits two or more of the customer's records and names none (code, before the answer step) | Which one do you mean? Tap it and I'll answer about that one. | تقصد أنهي واحدة؟ دوس عليها وأنا أجاوبك عنها. |
| R-HELLO | general.chitchat greeting, P4 | Hello, I'm Nova's assistant. I can explain a fee, tell you where your dispute is, or help replace a damaged or expiring card. A colleague is always one tap away. | أهلاً، أنا مساعد نوفا. أقدر أشرحلك أي رسوم، أقولك الاعتراض بتاعك وصل لفين، أو أساعدك تغيّر كارت بايظ أو هيخلص. وفي أي وقت تقدر تكلّم حد من زمايلنا. |

Every reply that hands off creates a ticket, so every one carries a reference. Change the wording here only with Compliance, and log the change in CHANGELOG.md.
